Your skills to build and practice exercise: Investment Banker
SKILLS TO BUILD

Critical analysis of AI-generated reports — Investment banking relies on accurate and insightful analysis, and while AI can quickly generate reports, the ability to critically review, question, and refine these outputs is crucial.

Strategic client communication — AI can draft basic messages, but the nuanced art of advising clients, understanding their deeper needs, and building long-term trust requires human communication skills.
PRACTICE EXERCISE

A good exercise would be to find a recent financial news article about a company that interests you. Then, use a free AI tool to create a short summary of the article and list three potential investment risks for that company. After that, review the AI's summary and risks. Identify any information the AI missed, misinterpreted, or any risks it overlooked. Based on your review, draft a short, clear email to a hypothetical client explaining one key risk you identified, making sure your language is easy to understand and builds trust, rather than just repeating what the AI said.
YOU WILL HAVE
You will have the original news article, the AI-generated summary and risk list, your notes highlighting the AI's strengths and weaknesses, and your personally drafted client email.
